svg.title: An old coefficient on occurrence set A gains (η/H)|A| after its cover costs are paid. A group’s allowance is the product of f Wi over its full fiber. Distinct occurrences keep distinct nilpotent markers. Eligible products have disjoint old marker sets, so their toll product is exactly the toll of their union and, for complete fibers, the corresponding product of group allowances. With occupancy at most s, scalar weighted bound a, activity bound b and Wi|ci| ≤T, the extended inventory envelope is γ = 2(1 + s)η(sTeα + a) + (1 + s)b. (OE10)
